name: Somogyhárságy (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of red and blue at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Somogyhárságy (a quartered shield of red and white with a fleur-de-lis, trefoils and a plough) above a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
